preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner/admin of the MasterChef contract
MasterChef contract must have lpToken balance > 0

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, first deploy a malicious migrator contract that implements a migrate() function which calls transferFrom() to transfer lpTokens from MasterChef to attacker's address. Then call setMigrator() on MasterChef to set the migrator address to your malicious contract. Finally, call migrate() on MasterChef with the pool ID containing lpTokens to drain all lpToken balances.
